I took Triceps Pushdown out of today's workout only. Your routine is unchanged. 💪 Dips and overhead extensions load the elbow even more, so I'd skip those too. I'm suggesting Low-to-High Cable Fly instead, which works your chest with little elbow stress. Keep the load light and the movement pain-free. If the elbow gets sharp or the pain lingers, stop and get it checked by a professional. Also watch for any twinge on your presses today.
